suggestions.title: Private refs are unique per head, not per run; the self-check case name overclaims
suggestions.failurePath: Two pr-gate runs on the same PR and the same head share refs. This happens when a run is relaunched (not resumed) while the first is still going, or when two sessions gate the same head. Both use refs/pr-gate/<pr>/<sha12>/<tag>/{base,head} (pr-gate.js:153-154). Whichever run finishes a dimension first runs `git update-ref -d` on the other run's refs. The other agent's `git diff <base>...<head>` then fails mid-review, and it either reports a mismatch or returns nothing. Both fail closed (go false), so the outcome is a spurious no-go, not a wrong go. The case title says "two runs on one PR do not delete each other's refs", but that only holds when the heads differ. The header comment at pr-gate.js:151-152 states the narrower and correct claim. A run nonce passed through args would close it, since Date.now/Math.random are unavailable in Workflow scripts.
suggestions.evidence: pr-gate.js:153-154 build the ref path only from pr, headSha.slice(0,12) and tag. selfcheck.mjs:469-483 checks only that every ref starts with refs/pr-gate/1/<HEAD12>/.

suggestions.title: LINES_CMD needs a git that knows --attr-source; stock Apple git on the recommended Mac host may not
suggestions.failurePath: The caller and the safety reviewer are told to compute linesChanged with `git -c core.quotePath=false --attr-source=4b825dc... diff --no-renames --numstat`. The global --attr-source option is newer than git 2.39, the version Apple's Command Line Tools ship (I recall 2.39.5 as of Xcode 16; not checked here). Spec 28 §7.2 recommends running the bootstrap on the Mac. With /usr/bin/git there, the documented command exits with an unknown-option error. The caller cannot build the args as specified, and the safety reviewer may improvise a count without the empty-tree attributes, which reopens the run-6 .gitattributes hole for its count. This fails loudly rather than silently, and git 2.43 in this container handles it, so it is not blocking. Spec 28 §7.5 could state the minimum git version, or the gate could ask the safety reviewer to report `git --version`.
suggestions.evidence: Ran the LINES_CMD on git 2.43.0 here: 30 rows, 4149 lines, which matches the PR body. Spec 28 line 200 recommends running on the Mac. The Apple git version is from memory, not verified in this session.

suggestions.title: D4 auto-merge set covers the code that enforces merge authority, agent permissions and future brakes
suggestions.failurePath: The #1256 hard blocks live in the auto-merge set: apps/server/src/services/chief-tools.ts:867-870 returns MERGE_HUMAN_ONLY_COPY, and mcp-face.ts:365 throws a 403. So do AGENT_TOOL_SWITCHES (packages/shared/src/records/agent.ts:51), the daemon bash command gate (apps/daemon/src/backend/command-gate.ts) and any future merge executor or autonomyPaused/daily-cap brake outside the three class-④ paths (pr-gate.js:73-75; ADR 0021 D4 ④). Take a later phase PR that changes only chief-tools.ts to drop the rejection, or loosens command-gate.ts. The head script returns mergedBy 'auto-merge' for it (stub-agent probe). Under spec 28 §7.4 and §8, the session then enables auto-merge for P5/P6 PRs routed this way, so the only check left is five LLM reviewers. The ADR D1 promise that `human` keeps the #1256 blocks rests on code that can be removed without a person. The PR's Risk section names this and defers it to P3/P4, so this is a gap in the class list, not a code defect at this head.

suggestions.title: Evidence dimension runs PR-quoted commands and pnpm install with session credentials, guarded only by prompt rules
suggestions.failurePath: The evidence reviewer runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and up to three commands quoted in the PR body's Verified section, in a worktree at the head, with the session's git and gh credentials. Two rules guard this, and neither is code. The first is a prompt rule to check head.repo.full_name first (lines 182 and 267). The second is spec 28 §7.5's rule to run pr-gate only on PRs this session wrote (spec 28 line 256), and the script cannot check it: args carry no author or head repo. Even on a same-repo PR, a change to root package.json `prepare` or to pnpm-workspace.yaml `allowBuilds` routes to the user under D4 class ③. But pr-gate runs before that user merge, so the evidence reviewer's install executes the PR's lifecycle scripts. CLAUDE.md does not allow postinstall scripts without explicit user consent. The risk is bounded because only collaborators can push same-repo branches, and the PR's Risk section acknowledges it.
suggestions.evidence: pr-gate.js:182: 'Re-run at most three of the narrowest commands quoted in the PR's Verified section ... after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`'. pnpm-workspace.yaml allowBuilds enables better-sqlite3 and esbuild. Root package.json:22 has prepare: husky. Suggested fix: when changedFiles hits class ③ (package.json, lockfile, pnpm-workspace.yaml, .npmrc), have the evidence prompt skip the install, or limit re-runs to a fixed set of command shapes.
